notes.title: STORAGE GUYS DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've got some exciting news - [b]Storage Guys Demo[/b] is coming to Steam tomorrow, [b]April 14th[/b] - just one day before the full game launch!

[h1]DEMO[/h1]
Play the free demo and jump in early to get a feel for the game. It gives you a solid preview of what’s coming in the full release - the storage management, item handling, and all the equipment you’ll be working with!

The demo will continue getting regular updates alongside the full game. It includes all the same core content, just in a limited version - but don’t worry, you’ll get a real taste of what Storage Guys is all about.

[h1]FULL GAME[/h1]
We’re excited to announce that [b]Storage Guys[/b] will officially launch on [b]April 15th, 2025[/b].

[b]Price[/b]: [b]$11.99[/b]
[b]Launch Discount[/b]: Enjoy a [b]20% discount[/b] for the first [b]two weeks[/b] after release!

Get ready to team up with your friends and take on the fun of warehouse management! Don’t forget to [b]wishlist[/b] the game and [b]stay tuned[/b] for more updates!

notes.title: RELEASE DELAY
notes.notes:
I owe you an apology. I know the game was supposed to come out on November 7th, and I’m sorry for not keeping you updated since then. As an indie dev, there’s a lot to keep up with, and I haven’t been able to manage everything all at once.

As you already saw, we have to delay the release again, this time without a set date. The plan is to put out a [b]Demo[/b] first, then launch the full game shortly after. I don’t have an exact date for the Demo yet, but I’ll announce it as soon as I can.

The Demo will cover the tutorial and give you a preview of the game. It’ll also be playable in co-op mode, so you can invite friends to try it with you!

Thanks for your patience and understanding. We’re working hard to make sure the game’s worth the wait, and we really appreciate your support so far!

notes.title: RELEASE DATE UPDATE
notes.notes:
We made the decision to delay the release of our game. The new release date is [b]November 7, 2024[/b].

We need just a bit more time to polish things up and make sure the game is released fully completed. Our goal is to deliver the best possible version of the game, with as few bugs and issues as possible.

You can expect [b]BETA testing[/b] at the end of October, with more news on this coming soon.

We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for your patience, and we can't wait for you to experience the game soon!
